answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, Python version pinned in .python-version). Install the way CI does with: uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all  (for a full dev environment, including the lint tools, use: uv sync --extra all)
answers.q2: bash scripts/run-tests.sh   (it sets PYTHONPATH=./docs_src and runs: pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/). Run it through uv if the venv isn't activated: uv run --no-sync bash scripts/run-tests.sh. CI itself runs: uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh
answers.q4: CI lints with pre-commit via prek, in .github/workflows/pre-commit.yml. Run: uv sync --locked --extra all && uv run prek run --all-files   (CI limits it to the PR diff: uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure). The hooks are ruff check, ruff format, mypy fastapi, ty check, typos, zizmor and the file-hygiene checks. Equivalent manual commands from scripts/check-style.sh: uv run mypy fastapi && uv run ty check && uv run ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts && uv run ruff format fastapi tests --check
answers.q5: Do not hand-edit: uv.lock (generated by uv; use uv lock or uv add instead). README.md is generated from docs/en/docs/index.md (uv run ./scripts/docs.py generate-readme). The sponsor banner partial docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html is generated by scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml. The translated docs under docs/<lang>/ (everything except docs/en/, e.g. docs/de/) are produced by the LLM translation workflow and checked by the ensure-non-translated hook. The language list is maintained by scripts/docs.py update-languages. Nothing is vendored. AGENTS.md says only uv.lock is a lockfile, but that file is a generated, partly unverified summary: its commands (uv run pytest, uv run mypy .) don't match CI.
